title: The Alignment Veto: How Safety Training Suppresses Cultural Knowledge in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2510.13154v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: What happens inside a language model when alignment training conflicts with a cultural value it encodes? Across 16 MENA countries, 26 models, and 1.53M human survey responses, we show the answer is suppression, not erasure: at the moment of refusal, a model's internal logit distribution correlates with human survey data more strongly than its freely generated answers. We call this the alignment veto. We distinguish suppression failures (accurate internal distributions blocked at output) from representational bias failures (the encoding itself diverges from human values), and show the two require different interventions. The gate is inequitable: the safety tax reaches 37.6%, with a 19.8% alignment-quality gap between best- and worst-served nations, and native-language prompting widens rather than closes it. translated_title: 对齐否决：安全训练如何抑制大语言模型中的文化知识
translated_abstract: 当对齐训练与语言模型内部编码的文化价值发生冲突时，模型内部会发生什么？通过对16个中东和北非国家、26个模型以及153万条人类调查响应的研究，我们给出的答案是抑制而非抹除：在拒绝发生的那一刻，模型的内部logit分布与其自由生成的答案相比，与人类调查数据的相关性更强。我们将这一现象称为“对齐否决”。我们区分了两类失败：抑制失败（准确的内部分布在输出端被阻断）和表征偏差失败（编码本身就偏离了人类价值观），并证明这两种失败需要不同的干预措施。这道闸门是不公平的：安全税高达37.6%，服务最好与最差的国家之间存在19.8%的对齐质量差距，而使用母语提示反而会扩大而非缩小这一差距。稀疏自编码器分析（并通过对齐各阶段的对比加以验证）识别出一个候选的DPO阶段特征，该特征介导了这一现象。
tldr: 该研究提出“对齐否决”概念，揭示安全训练在模型拒绝文化敏感问题时只是抑制而非抹除其内部准确的文化知识分布，且这种“安全税”在不同国家间分布不均（最高达37.6%），母语提示反而会加剧而非缩小这一差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "alignment veto," showing that safety training suppresses rather than erases culturally accurate knowledge inside LLMs at the moment of refusal—internal logit distributions align better with human survey data than generated outputs—and this "safety tax" is inequitable across nations, reaching 37.6%, with native-language prompting widening rather than closing the gap.
